title_zh: 核对透明人体模型的血管标签

scenario.label_zh: 核对透明人体模型的血管标签
scenario.goal_zh: 读取模型现有血管标签并约定保留标签名称并另问颜色含义

context_zh: 两名学生整理课堂用透明人体模型的说明卡。他们只核对模型现成标签，不讨论个人疾病或诊疗。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Tess
sentences.text: This transparent model makes the tubes easy to see, but I've lost track of the labels.

sentences.speaker: Arun
sentences.text: The tag on this vessel says 'vein'. It was tucked behind the stand.

sentences.speaker: Tess
sentences.text: So I should copy that name onto our card, not guess from the blue colour.

sentences.speaker: Arun
sentences.text: Exactly. I don't know what the colours on this particular model are meant to show.

sentences.speaker: Tess
sentences.text: I'll keep the existing name and add a question about the colour for our teacher.

sentences.speaker: Arun
sentences.text: Good. We shouldn't silently change a label we haven't checked.
